$comment: Example routing config for sg_route_tasks. Copy into your venture overlay / deployment glue and replace every <placeholder>. Each key under 'surfaces' MUST be a registered surface type — the package registers markdown, board, and external; a deployment may register its own adapters beside them. Real ids/keys are venture particulars: never commit them; the sanitization gate blocks a real one.

by_kind.$comment: Route by item kind. Actionable work (task/commitment) falls through to 'default'; informational warm updates go to the tended board so whatever tends it surfaces them next cycle.

by_owner.$comment: Optional per-person override, highest precedence. A member whose tasks land on their own surface. Keys are your own person slugs. Omit for team-wide routing only.

markdown.$comment: Fully implemented, no credentials required — writes a local board file. Set is_inbox true to designate a triage lane unattended runs may write to.

board.$comment: Writes garden-format board lines (- [ ] text #id) into a board file a tender (e.g. a gardener process) maintains. git_commit lets the tender pick changes up on its next pull.

external.$comment: A declared external tracker (Notion database, Linear team, GitHub Project, ...). Gates on the env var named here and refuses loudly until a deployment implements list_existing/write against its API.
external.impl_hint: query the tracker for existing items; create/update records mapping Item.kind/owner/due to its schema
